customersList.title: Customers
customersList.subtitle_one: {{company}} · {{count}} customer · each starts as a draft for KYC
customersList.subtitle_other: {{company}} · {{count}} customers · each starts as a draft for KYC
customersList.subtitleNone: Customers of the company you choose · each starts as a draft for KYC
customersList.adminNote: You are Admin: you can add, edit any field and deactivate. Other users follow the rights Admin gives them.
customersList.rightsNote: You see and change customers as your rights allow. Ask Admin for more.
customersList.viewOnly: You can see customers but not change them. Ask Admin for the sales rights.
customersList.removeAria: Remove {{name}} (not available: see What Remove does)
customersList.removeDisabled: A customer with documents can't be deleted. Use Deactivate, or Merge into another customer.
customersList.fromReceipts: How they paid, received, payments and last paid fill in from receipts in Phase 3.
customersList.emptyBody: Add a customer through Customer KYC, or load the customer masters from Tally.
customersList.noCompanies: No companies set up yet. Admin adds them on Companies.
customersList.foot: Names as the bank or Tally shows them; Edit fixes the spelling and adds GSTIN, address and contacts. A party under more than one name is merged into one.

confirmDeactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
confirmDeactivate.effect: No new orders or invoices for this customer. Past invoices and receipts stay in the books. You can reactivate later.

confirmReactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
confirmReactivate.effect: Orders and invoices can be raised for this customer again, as its KYC state allows.

removeCard.title: What Remove does
removeCard.noDocsLead: No invoices, receipts or orders yet:
removeCard.noDocs: the customer can be removed. The user log keeps who removed it and when.
removeCard.withDocs: Remove becomes Deactivate (no new orders or invoices) or Merge into another customer. Their past invoices stay, because the books must keep them.
removeCard.now: Until invoices exist (Phase 3), use Deactivate or Merge; nothing is deleted.

editCard.title: Edit any field
editCard.p1: Admin can change any field, on any customer, at any time. Each change keeps the old and new value, who changed it and when.
editCard.p2: A changed GSTIN or state applies to new invoices; invoices already issued are corrected with a credit note and a new invoice.

party.gstinHelp: 15 characters. The state comes from the first two and the PAN from characters 3–12.
party.gstinInvalid: This GSTIN is not valid: the format or check digit is wrong.
party.dupTitle_one: This looks like a party that already exists
party.dupTitle_other: This looks like {{count}} parties that already exist
party.dupNext: Open the existing one instead, or create a new party only if it really is different.
party.docsAfterSave: Save the draft first; then upload the documents here.
party.docExpiry: Expires on (if it has a date)
party.docExpiryHelp: A reminder goes out before it expires.
party.uploadFailed: The file could not be uploaded. Nothing was saved.

bank.firstHelp: Check it against a cancelled cheque or a penny-drop. Any later change needs a second person and a call-back to a known number.
bank.changeHelp: The account is not changed now. A second person calls the party on a known number, records the call-back, and approves.
bank.errIfsc: 11 characters: 4 letters, 0, then 6 letters or digits.
bank.errReason: Say why the account changes (at least 5 characters).

bankReq.title: Bank change requests
bankReq.callbackHelp: Call the party on a number you already know (not one given in the request) and confirm the new account. Someone other than the requester records it.
bankReq.note: What was confirmed on the call

rules.masters.possible_duplicate: This looks like a party that already exists. Open the existing one, or choose Create anyway if it really is different.
rules.party.company_required: Choose the company this party deals with.
rules.party.role_required: A party is a customer, a supplier or both.
rules.party.gstin_invalid: The GSTIN format or check digit is wrong. Check it on the certificate.
rules.party.gstin_pan_mismatch: The PAN inside the GSTIN (characters 3–12) differs from the PAN entered.
rules.party.pan_invalid: The PAN format is wrong: 5 letters, 4 digits, 1 letter.
rules.party.msme_terms: Terms longer than 45 days are refused under the MSME rule for this company.
rules.party.gstin_exists: A party with this GSTIN already exists. Open it and link this company instead.
rules.party.verified_locked: KYC is verified, so only Admin can change the name, GSTIN or PAN.
rules.party.missing: This party was not found. It may have been merged.
rules.party.gstin_required: A registered party needs its GSTIN before the KYC is verified.
rules.party.bad_status: That KYC step is not known.
rules.bank.change_needs_approval: This party already has a bank account. Request a change instead; a second person approves it.
rules.bank.callback_note: Note what was confirmed on the call (at least 5 characters).
rules.bank.callback_required: Record the call-back to a known number before approving.
rules.sod.self_approval: Nobody approves their own request: the person who proposed or asked for this can't verify, call back or approve it. Another person must do it.
